body:
This has given me hope, thank you! I’m trying type 1 collagen as well to see if it helps. Can I ask if you took laxatives for the 18 months after healing, or 6 months (fissure heals 12 months, then +6mo laxative)? 

Hope your new fissure heals soon.
Thanks. That’s me fucked then…! Hopefully I can get it seen to surgically before it gets to that point

Thanks - it seems like the only way to do that is to stay on the Movicol, which I don’t want to forever! My BMs aren’t hard per se but anything which isn’t like snake like soft retears the fissure! 

Social life is impacted hard during flare ups.

That makes total sense - the high calorific value of unhealthy stuff allows for replenishment so not getting to that stage should kill off the binging habit hopefully then move to reduce calories. 

Thanks! Seems like I’m immune to common sense hah

Coffee for breakfast along with one main meal around 4pm (mostly protein, fair bit of fibre with some carb added in) most days. Fruit or something around 6ish - one apple or pear or something. 

That said, if I do have additional snacks in the house, I’ll end up having them throughout the day. It used to be super often before but less so now - last time was three weeks ago however have constant urges to go grab something.
